name: Jesse James
text: Raid. Each time Jesse James destroys a unit, draw 1 and gain 2 money. Hard to Bury. The first time he is destroyed, he rides back in at the start of your next turn, exhausted.
quote: I know that we are outlaws, and that there is big money on our heads.
quoted: Jesse W. James, letter, History of Daviess County (1882)

name: Billy the Kid
text: Fast. Billy the Kid gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back.
quote: I am not afraid to die like a man fighting, but I would not like to be killed like a dog unarmed.
quoted: W. H. Bonney to Lew Wallace, 20 March 1879

name: Belle Starr
text: Harbor. While Belle Starr is on the board, enemy tricks cannot target your other units. Bandit Queen. Once each turn, when you play or deploy a Gang or Choir card, gain 1 money.
quote: I regard myself as a woman who has seen much of life.
quoted: Belle Starr, Fort Smith Elevator, as recorded in later Arkansas accounts of that interview

name: Cole Younger
text: Calls the Bluff. When the rival plays a trick, if Cole Younger is ready, you may exhaust him to cancel it.
quote: In the whole lot there could not be found six pages of truth.
quoted: Cole Younger, The Story of Cole Younger by Himself (1903)

name: Grave Round
text: Hot Load. Attach to one of your units. That unit’s next strike deals 2 extra damage; then exile Grave Round. If that strike destroys a unit, enemy tricks cannot target the bearer until your next turn.
quote: The good people of this world are very far from being satisfied with each other, and my arms are the best peacemakers.
quoted: Samuel Colt, letter to Charles Manby, 18 May 1852

name: Hell Rail
text: Iron Road. Place on an empty tile. When one of your units moves onto it, that unit may move one more tile. The first enemy unit to enter it loses 2 Power.
quote: I and Frank have been lied on and persecuted enough. We cannot stand everything.
quoted: Jesse W. James to Mr. Flood, 5 June 1875

name: Ride Back
text: Saddle Up. Return a Gang or Choir unit from your discard pile to your hand. Or, if your leader has fallen, bring the leader back onto the board, exhausted.
quote: The dirty little coward that shot Mr. Howard has laid poor Jesse in his grave.

name: Bass Reeves
text: Duty. The first strike against Bass Reeves each turn deals him no damage. Bring Them In. When he destroys a unit, draw 1 or look at the hidden tile nearest your units.
quote: He was never known to show the slightest excitement under any circumstance. He does not know what fear is.
quoted: Oklahoma City Weekly Times-Journal, on Bass Reeves

lead.label: Deputize
lead.text: Choose one of your units: it gains Tough, and the first time damage would destroy it, it stays at 1 Power instead. Draw 1.

name: Wyatt Earp
text: Steady. If you have not played or deployed a card this turn, Wyatt Earp deals 1 extra damage when he strikes, and the target cannot strike back.
quote: The mad merry scamp with heart of gold and nerves of steel.
quoted: Wyatt Earp on Doc Holliday, San Francisco Examiner, 2 August 1896

name: Wild Bill Hickok
text: Dead Man’s Hand. When Wild Bill is destroyed, he fires at an enemy unit next to him, dealing damage equal to his printed Power.
quote: While firing my last shot, I will gently breathe the name of my wife Agnes, and with wishes even for my enemies I will make the plunge and try to swim to the other shore.
quoted: J. B. Hickok, letter to Agnes Lake, 1876

name: Silver Star
text: Tin Star. Attach to one of your units. When that unit would move onto a tile hiding an enemy trap, it spots the trap and stays put.
quote: Place a warrant for arrest in his hands and no circumstance can cause him to deviate.
quoted: Oklahoma City Weekly Times-Journal, on Bass Reeves

name: Open Warrant
text: Wanted. Choose an enemy unit. It cannot move on its next turn.
quote: If the governor of our State will guarantee us a fair trial, we will surrender.
quoted: Jesse W. James, letter, History of Daviess County (1882)

name: Salt Line
text: Line in the Sand. Until your next turn, any enemy unit that strikes your leader loses 2 Power first.
quote: Treat all men alike. Give them the same laws. Give them all an even chance to live and grow.
quoted: Hinmatóowyalahtq̓it (Chief Joseph), North American Review, April 1879

name: Sitting Bull
text: Vision. While Sitting Bull is on the board, at the start of your turn look at the hidden tile nearest your units, and the first of your units to move that turn may move one extra tile.
quote: God made me an Indian.
quoted: Sitting Bull, as reported by Nelson A. Miles, Personal Recollections (1896)

lead.label: Rally the Camp
lead.text: Look at every hidden tile on your half. One of your units that has already acted may act again.

name: Geronimo
text: High Ground. Geronimo deals 2 extra damage, not 1, when he strikes from higher ground. Break Away. The first time damage would destroy him, he survives at 1 Power and slips to a nearby empty tile.
quote: I was born on the prairies where the wind blew free and there was nothing to break the light of the sun.
quoted: Geronimo, Geronimo's Story of His Life, ed. S. M. Barrett (1906)

name: Chief Joseph
text: Even Ground. While Chief Joseph is on the board, enemy ranged strikes cannot target your units.
quote: Let me be a free man, free to travel, free to stop, free to work, free to trade where I choose.
quoted: Hinmatóowyalahtq̓it (Chief Joseph), North American Review, April 1879

name: Quanah Parker
text: Two Roads. Once each turn, return an item or device the rival owns to the rival’s hand.
quote: I love my mother. I want my people to follow, get educated, know work, and make a living when the payments stop.
quoted: Quanah Parker, remarks at his mother's reburial (1910), Chronicles of Oklahoma (1921)

name: Painted Parfleche
text: Rawhide Case. Attach to one of your units. The first strike against that unit each turn deals 1 less damage.
quote: You might as well expect the rivers to run backward as that any man who was born a free man should be contented penned up.
quoted: Hinmatóowyalahtq̓it (Chief Joseph), North American Review, April 1879

name: Bone Whistle
text: Eagle-Bone Whistle. Exhaust: move one of your units one tile. It can still strike this turn.
quote: I was no chief and never had been, but because I had been more deeply wronged than others, this honor was conferred upon me.
quoted: Geronimo, Geronimo's Story of His Life, ed. S. M. Barrett (1906)

name: Thunder on the Ridge
text: Rolling Thunder. Choose one of your units. It deals 2 damage to an enemy unit within two tiles that is not on higher ground than it, and that enemy cannot climb on its next turn.
quote: The earth is the mother of all people, and all people should have equal rights upon it.
quoted: Hinmatóowyalahtq̓it (Chief Joseph), North American Review, April 1879

name: George Crook
text: Pack Train. While Crook is on the board, your devices cost 1 less. Remount. Once each turn, Crook can let one of your other units that has already acted act again.
quote: All the tribes tell the same story. They are surrounded on all sides, the game is destroyed or driven away, and there remains but one thing for them to do: fight while they can.
quoted: George Crook, on the tribes of the Plains

lead.label: Boots and Saddles
lead.text: All of your units may act again this turn. Draw 1.

name: Five in the Wheel
text: Empty Chamber. Attach to one of your units. The first time a strike would destroy that unit, it stays at 1 Power instead; then exile Five in the Wheel.
quote: The boldest plan is the best and safest.
quoted: J. B. Hickok, as reported by George Ward Nichols, Harper's New Monthly, February 1867

name: Signal Glass
text: Heliograph. Choose a tile and look at it. Then deal 1 damage to an enemy unit standing lower than that tile.
quote: Another reason was I wanted to make my own living and not be dependent on relations or friends.
quoted: Cathay Williams, St. Louis Daily Times, 2 January 1876

name: Dead Men's Volley
text: Volley Fire. Deal 2 damage to each enemy unit. Your units are not hit.
quote: Sometimes men fall down a shaft, there, a thousand feet deep. In such cases, the usual plan is to hold an inquest.

name: Shaft Viper
text: Rattler. Hide a viper on an empty tile; the rival is not shown which. The first unit of either side to enter it is destroyed.
quote: It is admitted that the rattlesnake has a poison-fang for its own defence and for the destruction of its prey.
quoted: Charles Darwin, On the Origin of Species, 6th edition (1872)

name: Switchman
text: Throw the Switch. When an enemy unit moves next to the Switchman, you may shove that unit onto another open tile beside it. If you do, it loses 1 Power.
quote: I have literally lived in the saddle.
quoted: Frank James, interview, Kansas City Journal, 7 October 1882

name: Faro Widow
text: Dealer’s Edge. While the Faro Widow is on the board, the first time each turn you play a trick, item or device, draw 1. She cannot move or strike the turn you deploy her.
quote: I have never known a day of perfect peace.
quoted: Frank James, interview, Kansas City Journal, 7 October 1882

name: Cinder Rider
text: Fast. Hell for Leather. The Cinder Rider may move one extra tile each turn. Each tile he leaves becomes a trap: the next enemy unit to enter it loses 2 Power.
quote: When I slept it was literally in the midst of an arsenal.
quoted: Frank James, interview, Kansas City Journal, 7 October 1882

name: Clay County Shade
text: Returns. The Clay County Shade is hard to bury: the first time he is destroyed, he rides back in at the start of your next turn, exhausted.
quote: If I heard dogs bark more fiercely than usual, I stood to my arms.
quoted: Frank James, interview, Kansas City Journal, 7 October 1882

name: Derringer
text: Hideout Gun. Attach to one of your units. That unit’s next strike lands first and deals 1 extra damage; then exile Derringer.
quote: I will never surrender to be mobbed by a set of bloodthirsty poltroons.
quoted: Jesse W. James, letter, History of Daviess County (1882)

name: False Coffin
text: Playing Dead. Choose a Gang or Choir unit in your discard pile. At the end of this turn, return it to your hand. Then exile False Coffin.
quote: I was tired of an outlaw's life.
quoted: Frank James, interview, Kansas City Journal, 7 October 1882

name: Riderless
text: Fast. Riderless strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back. Loose Horse. When you deploy him, you may move another of your units one tile.
quote: We left our six fine horses and took six mules in their place.

name: Night Wire
text: Barbed Wire. Place on an empty tile. Enemy units cannot move onto it. Exhaust: deal 1 damage to an enemy unit next to the wire.
quote: The coach we were in had a neat hole through its front—a reminiscence of its last trip through this region.

name: Powder Fuse
text: Light the Fuse. Exhaust: deal 2 damage to any unit. If that destroys it, deal 1 damage to an enemy unit next to where it stood.
quote: Think of that for perishable horse and human flesh and blood to do!

name: Widow Lamp
text: Lantern Light. Look at one tile. If a trap or device is there, you may move it to another empty tile; the rival is not shown where.
quote: We jumped into the stage, the driver cracked his whip, and we bowled away and left “the States” behind us.

name: Night Jailer
text: Hold. The Night Jailer pins enemies down: enemy units next to him cannot move, though they can still strike.
quote: The station-boss stopped dead still, and glared at me speechless.

name: Boot Hill Clerk
text: Body Count. When an enemy unit is destroyed, gain 1 money. The Boot Hill Clerk cannot move or strike the turn you deploy him.
quote: It was the loneliest land for a grave!

name: Silver Jury
text: Hung Jury. Choose an enemy unit. This turn it cannot strike or strike back.
quote: The “divide” was high, unoccupied ground, between the towns, the scene of twenty midnight murders and a hundred robberies.

name: Manacles
text: Irons. Attach to an enemy unit. It cannot move. On their turn, the rival may pay 2 money to break the Manacles and exile them.
quote: He carried no arms—he carried nothing that was not absolutely necessary.

name: Jail Key
text: Turnkey. Exile an item or device the rival owns. If it was attached to an enemy unit, that unit loses 1 Power.
quote: The building consisted of barns, stable-room for twelve or fifteen horses, and a hut for an eating-room for passengers.

name: Gallows Rope
text: Hangman’s Knot. Destroy an enemy unit with 2 Power or less. If there is none, draw 1 instead.
quote: Every twenty steps we passed the skeleton of some dead beast of burthen, with its dust-coated skin stretched tightly over its empty ribs.

name: Night Watch
text: On Watch. At the start of your turn, look at the hidden tile nearest your units. If it hides a trap, the next of your units that would step onto a trap spots it and stays put.
quote: Away across the endless dead level of the prairie a black speck appears against the sky, and it is plain that it moves.

name: Coroner's Table
text: Inquest. Whenever a unit is destroyed, look at the top card of your deck. If it is a Silver Star card, draw it.
quote: We gave up the breakfast, and paid our dollar apiece and went back to our mail-bag bed in the coach.

name: Posse Bell
text: Form a Posse. Exhaust: move up to two of your Silver Star units one tile each.
quote: We changed horses every ten miles, all day long, and fairly flew over the hard, level road.

name: Hang Fire
text: Slow. Hang Fire strikes last in melee. Late Shot. The first time a strike would destroy him, he stays at 1 Power and fires back at the unit that struck him, dealing damage equal to his full Power.
quote: Bemis did not want the mule; but the owner came out with a double-barreled shotgun and persuaded him to buy it, anyhow.

name: Night Ledger
text: Paper Trail. Pin to your leader. From then on, the first card you play or deploy each turn gains you 1 money.
quote: He had absolute charge of the mails, express matter, passengers and stage-coach, until he delivered them to the next conductor, and got his receipt for them.

name: Red Cloud
text: Treaty Terms. While Red Cloud is on the board, the rival’s devices cost 1 more. Once each turn, you may exhaust Red Cloud to let one of your other units that has already acted act again.
quote: The Great Father that made us both wishes peace to be kept; we want to keep peace.
quoted: Red Cloud, Cooper Union, New York, June 1870

lead.label: Red Cloud’s War
lead.text: The rival loses 1 money. One of your units that has already acted may act again.

name: Ridge Listener
text: Listener. When you deploy the Ridge Listener, look at one hidden tile. Climber. If his first move in a turn is a climb, it does not spend his move.
quote: I know every stream and every wood between the Rio Grande and the Arkansas.
quoted: Paruasemena (Ten Bears), Medicine Lodge council, October 1867

name: River That Remembers
text: Hidden Crossing. Move one of your units up to two tiles. It cannot strike this turn.
quote: I want to die there and not within walls.
quoted: Paruasemena (Ten Bears), Medicine Lodge council, October 1867

name: Painted Shield
text: War Shield. Attach to one of your units. The first strike against that unit each turn deals 1 less damage.
quote: They were not sweet like sugar, but bitter like gourds.
quoted: Paruasemena (Ten Bears), Medicine Lodge council, October 1867

name: Ten Bears
text: Peace Talker. While Ten Bears is on the board, the first strike against each of your units each turn deals that unit no damage.
quote: Do not ask us to give up the buffalo for the sheep.
quoted: Paruasemena (Ten Bears), Medicine Lodge council, October 1867

name: Winter Count
text: Keeping Count. Attach to one of your units. At the start of your turn, draw 1.
quote: I was born where there were no enclosures and everything drew a free breath.
quoted: Paruasemena (Ten Bears), Medicine Lodge council, October 1867

name: Pony Herd
text: Stampede. When you deploy the Pony Herd, you may move another of your units one tile.
quote: Along about an hour after breakfast we saw the first prairie-dog villages, the first antelope, and the first wolf.

name: Cold Ring
text: Snowbound. Choose a tile. Until your next turn, any unit on that tile cannot move.
quote: Ask anyone who has gone through our country to California; ask those who have settled there and in Utah, and you will find that we have treated them always well.
quoted: Red Cloud, Cooper Union, New York, June 1870

name: Empty Lodge
text: Harbor. The Empty Lodge draws enemy fire: while it is on the board, enemy tricks cannot target your other units. Left Behind. When it is destroyed, gain 2 money.
quote: Camp-fires and hot suppers in the deserts would be impossible but for the friendly sage-brush.

name: Buffalo Skull
text: Vengeance. Attach to one of your units. If a strike destroys that unit, the unit that struck it takes 2 damage.
quote: Then he and the waiting ravens explore the skeleton and polish the bones.

name: Trade Blanket
text: Fair Trade. Attach to one of your units. That unit gains 1 Power while it carries the blanket. Pay 1 money: move Trade Blanket to another of your units.
quote: When a party camps, the first thing to be done is to cut sage-brush.

name: Henry O. Flipper
text: Pack Train. While Flipper is on the board, your devices cost 1 less. Engineer. The first time each turn you play a device, draw 1.
quote: I wanted to prove that it was not done because of my color.
quoted: Henry O. Flipper, The Colored Cadet at West Point (1878)

name: Empty Guidon
text: Command. The Empty Guidon rallies the line: your other units next to it deal 1 extra damage when they strike. It cannot move or strike the turn you deploy it.
quote: War is cruelty, and you cannot refine it.
quoted: William T. Sherman to the Atlanta council, 12 September 1864

name: Last Sentry
text: Lookout. Each turn, the first enemy unit to move next to the Last Sentry loses 2 Power.
quote: You cannot qualify war in harsher terms than I will.
quoted: William T. Sherman to the Atlanta council, 12 September 1864

name: Gatling
text: Crank It. Exhaust: deal 1 damage to each enemy unit.
quote: It occurred to me that if I could invent a machine—a gun—that would by its rapidity of fire enable one man to do as much battle duty as a hundred it would to a great extent, supersede the necessity of large armies.
quoted: Richard J. Gatling, postwar letter, quoted in American Heritage, November 1987

name: Camp Bugle
text: Sound the Charge. Exhaust: one of your Army units that has already acted may act again.
quote: From the moment I reached Sill I haven't experienced any thing but happiness.
quoted: Henry O. Flipper, The Colored Cadet at West Point (1878)

name: Supply Wagon
text: Supply Run. Exhaust: gain 2 money, or only 1 if an enemy unit is next to your stronghold.
quote: There was a great pile of it strapped on top of the stage, and both the fore and hind boots were full.

name: Picket Line
text: Picket. When an enemy unit moves next to the Picket Line, that unit loses 1 Power and cannot strike this turn.
quote: The stage-coach traveled about a hundred to a hundred and twenty-five miles a day, the pony-rider about two hundred and fifty.

name: Surgeon's Roll
text: Field Dressing. Attach to one of your units. The first time that unit takes damage and survives, it regains up to 2 lost Power; then exile Surgeon’s Roll.
quote: I have been disposed not only to overlook the offence, but to forgive and forget it.
quoted: Henry O. Flipper, The Colored Cadet at West Point (1878)

name: Bluff Gun
text: Big Gun. Exhaust: deal 3 damage to an enemy unit.
quote: Our coach was a great swinging and swaying stage, of the most sumptuous description—an imposing cradle on wheels.

name: Cut Wire
text: Cut the Wire. Place on an empty tile. While it is on the board, enemy tricks cost 1 more, and no unit can move onto that tile.
quote: We were spinning along through Kansas, and in the course of an hour and a half we were fairly abroad on the great Plains.

name: Empty Saddle
text: Riderless Horse. When another of your Army units (not your leader) is destroyed, you may exhaust Empty Saddle to return that unit to your hand.
quote: His horse was stripped of all unnecessary weight, too.

name: Sibley
text: Canvas Cover. Place on a tile. Enemy tricks cannot target your units on that tile.
quote: We took two or three blankets for protection against frosty weather in the mountains.

name: Ambulance
text: Litter Wagon. Exhaust: move one of your units up to two tiles. It cannot strike this turn.
quote: We breakfasted at Horse-Shoe Station, six hundred and seventy-six miles out from St. Joseph.

name: George Armstrong Custer
text: Fast. Custer gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back.
quote: If I were an Indian, I think that I would greatly prefer to cast my lot with those of my people who adhered to the free life of the plains rather than to the limits of a reservation.
quoted: George Armstrong Custer, My Life on the Plains (1874)

name: Nelson A. Miles
text: Tough. Nelson Miles is hard as rawhide: whenever he takes damage, he takes 1 less.
quote: The most abominable criminal military blunder and a horrible massacre of women and children.
quoted: Nelson A. Miles to his wife, on Wounded Knee, December 1890

name: Cathay Williams
text: Tough. Cathay Williams is hard as rawhide: whenever she takes damage, she takes 1 less.
quote: Only two persons, a cousin and a particular friend, members of the regiment, knew that I was a woman.
quoted: Cathay Williams, St. Louis Daily Times, 2 January 1876

name: Frederick Benteen
text: Tough. Benteen is hard as rawhide: whenever he takes damage, he takes 1 less.
quote: My Lie on the Plains.
quoted: Frederick Benteen, on Custer's My Life on the Plains

name: Elfego Baca
text: Tough. Elfego Baca is hard as rawhide: whenever he takes damage, he takes 1 less.
quote: I will show the Texans there is at least one Mexican in the county who is not afraid of an American cowboy.

name: Pat Garrett
text: Ranged. Pat Garrett can also shoot an enemy two tiles away in a straight line, and that target cannot strike back.
quote: He never spoke. A struggle or two, a little strangling sound as he gasped for breath, and the Kid was with his many victims.
quoted: Pat Garrett, The Authentic Life of Billy the Kid (1882)

name: Doc Holliday
text: Fast. Doc Holliday gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back.
quote: This is funny.
quoted: John H. Holliday, last words, Glenwood Springs, 8 November 1887

name: Bat Masterson
text: Tough. Bat Masterson is hard as rawhide: whenever he takes damage, he takes 1 less.
quote: I never killed a white person that I remember. Might have aimed my gun at one or two.
quoted: W. B. Masterson to the New York Times, 1905

name: Mine Shaft
text: Bottomless Shaft. Hide a mine shaft on an empty tile; the rival is not shown which. The first unit of either side to enter it is destroyed.
quote: The alkali dust cut through our lips, it persecuted our eyes, it ate through the delicate membranes and made our noses bleed.

name: Alkali Sink
text: Alkali Sink. Hide a sink on an empty tile; the rival is not shown which. The first unit of either side to enter it loses 3 Power and cannot move on its next turn.
quote: It was like drinking lye, and not weak lye, either.

name: Deadfall
text: Deadfall. Hide a deadfall on an empty tile; the rival is not shown which. The first unit of either side to enter it loses 2 Power and cannot strike this turn.
quote: Imagine a vast, waveless ocean stricken dead and turned to ashes.

name: Cave-In
text: Cave-In. Hide a collapse on an empty tile; the rival is not shown which. The first unit of either side to enter it is destroyed, and one enemy item or device next to it is exiled.
quote: The sage-brush is a singularly hardy plant, and grows right in the midst of deep sand, and among barren rocks.

name: Sasquatch
text: Cryptid. Tough. Whenever Sasquatch takes damage, it takes 1 less. Tall Tale. The first time it would take damage or lose Power, it takes none.
quote: His nostrils were struck by a strong, wild-beast odor, and he caught the loom of a great body in the darkness at the mouth of the lean-to.

name: Thunderbird
text: Cryptid. Thunderclap. When you deploy the Thunderbird, deal 1 damage to each enemy unit.
quote: You have heard the Thunder, for he is everywhere.
quoted: George Bird Grinnell, Blackfeet Indian Stories (1913)

name: Piasa
text: Cryptid. Bounty. When the Piasa destroys a unit, gain 2 money. Looming. While it is on the board, each unit the rival deploys loses 1 Power.
quote: They have horns on their heads like those of deer, a horrible look, red eyes.
quoted: Jacques Marquette, journal of the 1673 voyage

name: Tommyknockers
text: Cryptid. Knocking. Once each turn, look at one tile; if a trap is there, you may move it to another empty tile. The Tommyknockers cannot move or strike the turn you deploy them.
quote: We must not look at goblin men, we must not buy their fruits.

name: Cactus Cat
text: Cryptid. Fast. The Cactus Cat strikes first in melee, and an enemy it kills cannot strike back. Rustler. When it destroys a unit, the rival loses 1 money.
quote: The cactus cat has thorny hair, the thorns being especially long and rigid on its ears.
quoted: William T. Cox, Fearsome Creatures of the Lumberwoods (1910)

name: Hodag
text: Cryptid. Bully. When you deploy the Hodag, choose an enemy unit: it cannot move or strike on its next turn. Traps cannot destroy the Hodag.
quote: The outward and visible sign of an inward fear.

name: The Raven
text: Ill Omen. Return a unit on the board to its owner’s hand. A leader goes back to its owner’s tray instead, and that player discards a card at random.
quote: Quoth the Raven, "Nevermore."

name: Mothman
text: Cryptid. Ranged. The Mothman can also strike an enemy two tiles away in a straight line, and that target cannot strike back.
quote: And his eyes have all the seeming of a demon's that is dreaming.

name: Black Dog
text: Cryptid. Fast. The Black Dog strikes first in melee, and an enemy it kills cannot strike back. Tracker. The first time an enemy unit crosses onto your half, you may move the dog next to it.
quote: Listen to them—the children of the night. What music they make!

name: The Yellow Sign
text: Card Sharp. Look at the rival’s hand and choose a card; the rival discards it. Gain 1 money.
quote: Strange is the night where black stars rise.
quoted: Robert W. Chambers, The King in Yellow (1895)

name: At the Window
text: Lamp in the Window. Look at every hidden tile. Then destroy one enemy trap, or deal 2 damage to an enemy unit.
quote: I was aware of a person on the other side of the window and looking straight in.
quoted: Henry James, The Turn of the Screw (1898)

name: Haunted Chamber
text: Locked Room. Choose a unit. Until your next turn, it cannot move or strike, and tricks played by its enemies cannot target it.
quote: One need not be a chamber to be haunted.

name: The Damned Thing
text: Cryptid. Unseen. Enemy tricks and ranged strikes cannot target the Damned Thing, and units it strikes cannot strike back.
quote: It was as if something had passed along between me and them; but I could not see it.

name: Owl Creek
text: Hanging Bridge. Destroy any unit with 2 Power or less. Its owner draws 1.
quote: A man stood upon a railroad bridge in northern Alabama, looking down into the swift water twenty feet below.
quoted: Ambrose Bierce, An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge (1890)

name: Bear Lake Monster
text: Cryptid. Hold. Enemy units next to the Bear Lake Monster cannot move, though they can still strike.
quote: They represent it as being of the serpent kind, but having legs about eighteen inches long.
quoted: Joseph C. Rich, letter, Deseret Evening News (1868)

name: Hidebehind
text: Cryptid. Ambush. Hide the Hidebehind on an empty tile; the rival is not shown which. The first enemy unit to enter that tile takes 3 damage, and the Hidebehind appears there or beside it, exhausted.
quote: It is too incredible, too monstrous; such things can never be in this quiet world.
quoted: Arthur Machen, The Great God Pan (1894)

name: La Llorona
text: Cryptid. Weeping. When you deploy La Llorona and at the start of your turn, the strongest enemy next to her cannot move on its next turn. The first time she is destroyed, she returns to your hand; lose 2 money.
quote: Be with me always—take any form—drive me mad!

name: Sleepy Hollow Rider
text: Cryptid. Fast. Headless. After the Rider strikes and survives, you may move it one tile. A unit it destroys is exiled, and that unit’s “when destroyed” abilities do not happen.
quote: The apparition of a figure on horseback, without a head.
quoted: Washington Irving, The Legend of Sleepy Hollow (1820)

name: Leeds Devil
text: Cryptid. Winged. You may deploy the Leeds Devil on any empty tile outside the rival’s half. Enemy tricks cannot target it the turn you deploy it.
quote: Beware, for I am fearless and therefore powerful.

name: Goodman Brown's Path
text: Wrong Turn. Choose a unit. It cannot move or strike until your next turn. Draw 1.
quote: The fiend in his own shape is less hideous than when he rages in the breast of man.

name: Carmilla
text: Night Visitor. Attach to an enemy unit. At the start of each of your turns, that unit loses 1 Power. If it is destroyed while Carmilla is attached, draw 1 and gain 2 money.
quote: You are mine, you shall be mine, you and I are one for ever.

name: Frank James
quote: I have been hunted for twenty-one years, have literally lived in the saddle, have never known a day of perfect peace.
quoted: Frank James on his surrender to Gov. Crittenden, October 1882
text: Brothers in the Saddle. While your leader is on the board, Frank James deals 1 extra damage when he strikes.

name: Sam Bass
quote: The world is bobbing around me.
quoted: Sam Bass, last words, Round Rock, Texas, 21 July 1878
text: Train Robber. When Sam Bass destroys a unit, gain 1 money.

name: Black Bart
quote: I’ve labored long and hard for bread, for honor and for riches, but on my corns too long you’ve tread, you fine-haired sons of bitches.
quoted: Verse left at a robbed Wells Fargo stage, 1877
text: Poet Bandit. When Black Bart destroys a unit, draw 1.

name: Pearl Hart
quote: I shall not consent to be tried under a law in which my sex had no voice in making.
quoted: Pearl Hart at her trial, Florence, Arizona, 1899
text: Fast. Pearl Hart gets the jump: she strikes first in melee, and an enemy she kills cannot strike back. Stage Holdup. When you deploy her, the rival loses 1 money.

name: Henry Starr
quote: I’ve robbed more banks than any man in America.
text: Bank Man. When Henry Starr steps onto a money claim you do not hold, gain 2 money.

name: Dynamite Dick
quote: Dan Clifton rode with the Doolins and earned the name the slow way: one fuse at a time.
text: Short Fuse. When Dynamite Dick is destroyed, deal 1 damage to each enemy unit next to him.

name: Kid Curry
quote: The most vicious outlaw in America.
quoted: Attributed to William Pinkerton, of Harvey Logan
text: Fast. Kid Curry gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back.

name: The Sundance Kid
quote: Harry Longabaugh took his name from a Wyoming jail and never gave it back.
text: Hit and Run. After the Sundance Kid strikes and survives, he may move one tile.

name: Joaquin Murrieta
quote: Joaquin is dead, they say. Then who rode through Sonora last night?
text: Returns. Joaquin Murrieta is hard to bury: the first time he is destroyed, he rides back in at the start of your next turn, exhausted.

name: Jackalope
quote: The licence is good from midnight to two, and only for a man who does not drink.
text: Cryptid. Fast. The Jackalope strikes first in melee, and an enemy it kills cannot strike back. Lucky Find. When you deploy it, draw 1.

name: The Lost Dutchman
quote: No miner will ever find my mine.
text: Lost Mine. When the Lost Dutchman is destroyed, draw 2.

name: Cousin Jack
quote: Wherever there is a hole in the ground, you will find a Cornishman at the bottom of it.
text: Hard Rock. When you deploy Cousin Jack, look at one hidden tile. Traps cannot destroy him, though they can still hurt him.

name: Tom Horn
quote: Killing men is my specialty. I look at it as a business proposition, and I think I have a corner on the market.
quoted: Attributed to Tom Horn, hanged at Cheyenne in 1903
text: Ranged. Tom Horn can also shoot an enemy two tiles away in a straight line, and that target cannot strike back.

name: Black Jack Ketchum
quote: I’ll be in hell before you start breakfast, boys! Let her rip!
quoted: Tom Ketchum on the gallows, Clayton, New Mexico, 26 April 1901
text: Last Word. When Black Jack Ketchum is destroyed, he deals 2 damage to an enemy unit next to him.

name: Lester Moore
quote: Here lies Lester Moore. Four slugs from a .44. No Les, no more.
text: Returns. Lester Moore is hard to bury: the first time he is destroyed, he rides back in at the start of your next turn, exhausted.

name: The Bell Witch
quote: I would rather fight the British again than have any more dealings with that torment.
text: Cryptid. Torment. When you deploy her, the rival discards a card at random.

name: Alferd Packer
quote: There was seven Democrats in Hinsdale County, and you ate five of them.
quoted: Apocryphal sentence of Judge M. B. Gerry, 1883
text: Hungry. When Alferd Packer destroys a unit, he gains 1 Power for good and regains all lost Power.

name: La Lechuza
quote: If the owl calls your name at the window, do not answer it.
text: Cryptid. Winged. You may deploy La Lechuza on any empty tile outside the rival’s half. Owl’s Cry. When you deploy her, deal 1 damage to an enemy unit.

name: One-Eyed Charley
quote: Charley Parkhurst drove stage for twenty years. The town learned she was a woman when they laid her out.
text: Fast. One-Eyed Charley gets the jump: she strikes first in melee, and an enemy she kills cannot strike back. Driver’s Secret. When Charley is destroyed, draw 1.

name: Resurrection Man
quote: Nobody stays buried in a town that pays by the pound.
text: Grave Robber. When you deploy the Resurrection Man, you may return a unit card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Boot Hill Undertaker
quote: Measure twice. Somebody always comes back for the second box.
text: Pine Boxes. Once each turn, when any unit is destroyed, gain 1 money.

name: Circuit Rider
quote: There is nothing out today but crows and Methodist preachers.
text: Camp Meeting. When you deploy the Circuit Rider, one of your units regains up to 2 lost Power.

name: The Weeping Bride
quote: She is still waiting at the chapel door. Do not walk past her.
text: Left at the Altar. When you deploy the Weeping Bride, the strongest enemy unit next to her cannot move on its next turn.

name: Hearse Driver
quote: Nobody passes the hearse. Nobody.
text: Last Ride. After the Hearse Driver strikes and survives, he may move one tile.

name: Night Deaconess
quote: Sing the second verse slower. They are listening.
text: Harbor. The Night Deaconess draws enemy fire: while she is on the board, enemy tricks cannot target your other units.

name: Brother Lazarus
quote: Lazarus, come forth.
text: Returns. Brother Lazarus is hard to bury: the first time he is destroyed, he rides back in at the start of your next turn, exhausted.

name: Midnight Organist
quote: Play it again, softer. The dead keep time.
text: Dirge. Once each turn, when another of your units is destroyed, draw 1.

name: Heck Thomas
quote: One of the Three Guardsmen. He ran Bill Doolin to ground in 1896.
text: Manhunter. When Heck Thomas destroys a unit, draw 1.

name: Bill Tilghman
quote: He would charge hell with a bucket of water.
quoted: Attributed to Theodore Roosevelt, of Tilghman
text: Steady. If you have not played or deployed a card this turn, Bill Tilghman deals 1 extra damage when he strikes, and the target cannot strike back.

name: Chris Madsen
quote: The Dane of the Three Guardsmen. He said he had served in the French Foreign Legion, and nobody tested it.
text: Tough. Chris Madsen is hard as rawhide: whenever he takes damage, he takes 1 less.

name: Judge Roy Bean
quote: Hang ’em first, try ’em later.
text: Law West of the Pecos. When you deploy Judge Roy Bean, choose an enemy unit: it cannot move on its next turn. Roy Bean cannot move or strike the turn you deploy him.

name: Capt. Bill McDonald
quote: No man in the wrong can stand up against a fellow that’s in the right and keeps on a-comin’.
text: Tough. Capt. McDonald is hard as rawhide: whenever he takes damage, he takes 1 less.

name: Judge Isaac Parker
quote: I never hanged a man. It is the law.
quoted: Attributed to Judge Isaac C. Parker
text: Hanging Judge. When you deploy Judge Parker, destroy an enemy unit with 2 Power or less. He cannot move or strike the turn you deploy him.

name: George Maledon
quote: I never hanged a man who came back to have the job done over.
quoted: Attributed to George Maledon, Fort Smith
text: Hangman. Once each turn, when an enemy unit is destroyed, gain 1 money.

name: Seth Bullock
quote: Deadwood’s first sheriff. Hickok was already dead; Bullock made sure the town noticed the law had arrived anyway.
text: Hold. Seth Bullock pins enemies down: enemy units next to him cannot move, though they can still strike.

name: Buffalo Bill Cody
quote: Every Indian outbreak that I have ever known has resulted from broken promises and broken treaties by the government.
text: Ranged. Buffalo Bill can also shoot an enemy two tiles away in a straight line, and that target cannot strike back. Scout. When you deploy him, look at one hidden tile.

name: Comanche
quote: Will be kindly cared for and his life preserved to the utmost limit.
quoted: General Orders No. 7, 7th Cavalry, 1878, of the horse Comanche
text: Survivor. The first time Comanche would take damage or lose Power, he takes none.

name: Sgt. Emanuel Stance
quote: Gallantry on scout after Indians.
text: Fast. Sgt. Stance gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back.

name: Al Sieber
quote: Chief of scouts in Arizona for most of twenty years. He carried more lead in him than most men fired.
text: Chief of Scouts. When you deploy Al Sieber, look at one hidden tile. Climber. If his first move in a turn is a climb, it does not spend his move.

name: Tom Custer
quote: Two Medals of Honor in the war, both for taking a flag. He died a few yards from his brother.
text: Two Medals. When Tom Custer destroys a unit, draw 1.

name: Ambrose Bierce
quote: Peace, n. In international affairs, a period of cheating between two periods of fighting.
text: Surveyor. When you deploy Ambrose Bierce, look at one hidden tile. When he is destroyed, draw 1.

name: Telegrapher
quote: What hath God wrought.
text: On the Wire. Once each turn, when you play a device, gain 1 money.

name: Mule Skinner
quote: A mule will work for you ten years for the chance to kick you once.
text: Supply. When you deploy the Mule Skinner, gain 1 money.

name: Col. Benjamin Grierson
quote: A music teacher who disliked horses, he led the longest cavalry raid of the war and then the 10th Cavalry.
text: Command. Grierson rallies the line: your other units next to him deal 1 extra damage when they strike.

name: Mountain Gun Crew
quote: Elevation two. Wait for the smoke.
text: Ranged. The Gun Crew can also shoot an enemy two tiles away in a straight line, and that target cannot strike back. It cannot move or strike the turn you deploy it.

name: The Lady in Green
quote: She rides out of the river fog at Fort Laramie and never leaves a track.
text: Cryptid. Winged. You may deploy the Lady in Green on any empty tile outside the rival’s half. Chill. When you deploy her, choose an enemy unit: it cannot move or strike on its next turn.

name: Gall
quote: War leader beside Sitting Bull at the Greasy Grass. Ten years later he walked the field again for the anniversary.
text: Fast. Gall gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back.

name: Rain-in-the-Face
quote: Named for a fight in the rain, when the paint on his face ran and he kept fighting.
text: Last Shot. When Rain-in-the-Face is destroyed, he fires at an enemy unit next to him, dealing damage equal to his printed Power.

name: Moving Robe Woman
quote: Her brother died at the Rosebud. She rode into the Greasy Grass a week later to answer for him.
text: Fast. Moving Robe Woman gets the jump: she strikes first in melee, and an enemy she kills cannot strike back. Avenger. When she destroys a unit, draw 1.

name: Two Moons
quote: The shooting was quick, quick. Pop—pop—pop very fast.
text: Command. Two Moons rallies the line: your other units next to him deal 1 extra damage when they strike.

name: Lozen
quote: Lozen is my right hand. Strong as a man, braver than most, and cunning in strategy. Lozen is a shield to her people.
quoted: Victorio, of his sister, as remembered by the Chiricahua
text: Enemy-Sense. When you deploy Lozen, look at every hidden tile.

name: Victorio
quote: He held the Black Range against two armies for a year, and was never taken.
text: High Ground. Victorio deals 2 extra damage, not 1, when he strikes from higher ground.

name: Satanta
quote: I love the land and the buffalo and will not part with it.
text: Orator. When you deploy Satanta, gain 1 money and the rival loses 1 money.

name: Standing Bear
quote: That hand is not the color of yours, but if I prick it, the blood will flow, and I shall feel pain.
text: Tough. Standing Bear is hard as rawhide: whenever he takes damage, he takes 1 less.

name: Buffalo Calf Road Woman
quote: The Battle Where the Girl Saved Her Brother.
quoted: Cheyenne name for the fight on the Rosebud, 1876
text: Rescue. When you deploy Buffalo Calf Road Woman, you may move another of your units one tile.

name: Cochise
quote: You must speak straight so that your words may go as sunlight into our hearts.
quoted: Cochise to Gen. O. O. Howard, 1872
text: Hold. Cochise pins enemies down: enemy units next to him cannot move, though they can still strike.

name: Mustang Runner
quote: Run them until the dust gives out, then run them some more.
text: Fast. The Mustang Runner gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back. Open Range. He may move one extra tile each turn.

name: White Bull
quote: Nephew of Sitting Bull. He kept count of his coups all his life and could name every one.
text: Counts Coup. When White Bull destroys a unit, draw 1 and gain 1 money.

name: Crazy Horse
quote: We preferred hunting to a life of idleness on the reservation, where we were driven against our will.
text: Fast. Crazy Horse gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back. Hit and Run. After he strikes and survives, he may move one tile.

name: American Horse
quote: There was a woman with an infant in her arms who was killed as she almost touched the flag of truce.
quoted: American Horse, testimony on Wounded Knee, Washington, February 1891
text: Harbor. American Horse draws enemy fire: while he is on the board, enemy tricks cannot target your other units.

name: Young Man Afraid of His Horses
quote: The name means his enemies feared even his horses.
text: Hold. Young Man Afraid pins enemies down: enemy units next to him cannot move, though they can still strike.

name: High Backbone
quote: He led the decoys at Fort Phil Kearny. Eighty soldiers followed them over the ridge.
text: Decoy. The first time damage would destroy High Backbone, he survives at 1 Power and slips to a nearby empty tile.

name: Roman Nose
quote: His bonnet kept him through every fight until Beecher Island.
text: War Bonnet. The first time Roman Nose would take damage or lose Power, he takes none.

name: Black Elk
quote: The nation’s hoop is broken and scattered. There is no center any longer.
quoted: Black Elk Speaks (1932), as told to John G. Neihardt
text: Healer. When you deploy Black Elk, one of your units regains up to 2 lost Power, and you look at one hidden tile.

name: Little Big Man
quote: Small, hard, and quick to take hold of a man’s arm. Every camp knew him by it.
text: Strong Grip. When you deploy Little Big Man, choose an enemy unit: it cannot move or strike on its next turn.

name: Tall Bull
quote: Dog Soldier chief. At Summit Springs he held the ravine so the families could get clear.
text: Hold. Tall Bull pins enemies down: enemy units next to him cannot move, though they can still strike.

name: Dog Soldier
quote: A sash pinned to the earth. He does not leave until a friend pulls the pin.
text: Hold. The Dog Soldier pins enemies down: enemy units next to him cannot move, though they can still strike.

name: Morning Star
quote: Called Dull Knife by the Lakota. He led his people out of Fort Robinson in the January snow, going home.
text: The Way Home. At the start of your turn, gain 1 money.

name: Little Wolf
quote: Sweet Medicine chief. He brought his band north fifteen hundred miles with three armies looking for him.
text: Long Walk. Little Wolf may move one extra tile each turn.

name: Weather Watcher
quote: The wind turns before the herd does. Watch the wind.
text: Weather Eye. When you deploy the Weather Watcher, look at one hidden tile. At the start of your turn, look at the hidden tile nearest your units.

name: Lodge Keeper
quote: The door faces east. Whatever comes in, comes in where I can see it.
text: Harbor. The Lodge Keeper draws enemy fire: while he is on the board, enemy tricks cannot target your other units.

name: Ridge Runner
quote: Up is always shorter than around.
text: Fast. The Ridge Runner gets the jump: he strikes first in melee, and an enemy he kills cannot strike back. Climber. If his first move in a turn is a climb, it does not spend his move.

name: Black Coal
quote: Arapaho chief. He bargained his people onto the Wind River when no one else would make room.
text: Provider. When you deploy Black Coal, gain 1 money and draw 1.

name: Hail Caller
quote: The sky over the ridge went green, then white, then loud.
text: Hailstorm. When you deploy the Hail Caller, deal 1 damage to an enemy unit.
